thread:
joel: spotting weirdness: several tenants' console "available" tokens dropped to negative shortly after we flipped in-flight routing-priority tagging. No invoice anomalies yet.

anya: same here. flip at 04:40 UTC. I see duplicate preview increments where routing_priority was set. Looks like preview dedupe ignored priority tag.

harris: quick log snippet: `emit_preview(tenant=t-22, req=0xabc, tokens=120, priority=high)` then later `emit_preview(tenant=t-22, req=0xabc, tokens=120, priority=low)` -> both counted. dedupe key currently `req` only.

metering-bot: alert: preview.dup_increment_rate high for t-22 (5m avg = 8)

ops-lee: is this expected? routing-priority was meant to be orthogonal; we shouldn't double-count. Preview pipeline should dedupe on (req, fingerprint) not just req. Did we miss a rollout step?

anya: rollout notes said "no contract change" but we actually added `routing_priority` to upstream envelope. Preview-agg assumed stable envelope.

joel: remediation idea: short term -> feature-flag preview UI to hide preview counts for orgs with negative available; ops-lee can toggle. Medium -> update preview-agg dedupe to include normalized priority in dedupe key; also widen dedupe window from 25s -> 90s while rolling. Long -> add schema compatibility test to routing-policy rollouts.

harris: patch is tiny: `dedupe_key = f"{req_id}|{normalize_priority(p)}"`. Need to be careful with tombstoning older entries. We'll also add integration test that simulates out-of-order arrival.

ops-lee: I'll toggle UI hide for affected tenants now. Which tenants are impacted? list?

anya: current list from quick query: t-22, t-77, reseller-r2 (and two sub-tenants). Pushing list to ops-lee DM.

triage-bot: INC-2026-0704-512 created, severity=P2; assigned: joel (owner), harris (patch), anya (recompute verification), ops-lee (UI toggle + canary), devex (messaging).

joel: estimated timeline: harris can PR in ~2h, canary to 2 preview shards in 3h, full rollout in 6h if green. I want the UI hide until verification done.

harris: PR will include unit tests + backfill helper to recompute preview aggregates for affected windows. Will also add a telemetry gauge `preview_minus_ledger_tokens` per tenant.

ops-lee: UI toggle applied for listed tenants. Banner: "Preview estimates temporarily hidden for billing schema rollouts. Final invoices unaffected."

anya: running recompute for 04:30-05:00 window for impacted tenants; will diff ledger vs preview after the patch.

joel: postmortem note: rollout checklist entry missing: "confirm preview dedupe contract covers new routing metadata fields." Adding to playbook. Also add automation: preflight contract test that runs against preview-agg on staging.

metering-bot: INC-2026-0704-512 status -> in_progress

harris: PR opened https://gh/redwood/preview-agg/pull/2200 feature-flagged. Canary scheduled.

ops-lee: canary looks stable for 1h, preview delta down to baseline for test tenants. scheduling full rollout now. Will keep dedupe window elevated for 24h.

joel: thanks everyone. leaving incident open until recompute diffs validate. Will draft short postmortem once complete.
